// Positive control (#5170): the catch assigns an empty value to the result and then returns it.
import fs from 'node:fs';

export function readPlanText(planPath: string): string {
  let text = 'unset';
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    text = '';
    return text;
  }
  return text;
}
